questions.question: How many bones does an adult human body have?
questions.explanation: Adults have 206 bones! Babies are born with about 270, some fuse together as they grow! 🦴

questions.question: Which is the largest organ in the human body?
questions.explanation: Skin is the largest organ! It covers your entire body and protects you! 🫁

questions.question: How many teeth does a human adult have?
questions.explanation: Adult humans have 32 teeth including the wisdom teeth! 🦷

questions.question: Which part of the body pumps blood?
questions.explanation: Your heart pumps blood non-stop — about 100,000 times every day! ❤️

questions.question: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.explanation: The heart has 4 chambers — 2 atria and 2 ventricles! 💓

questions.question: Which organ controls everything in your body?
questions.explanation: Your brain is the control centre — it sends signals to every part of your body! 🧠

questions.question: What do red blood cells carry?
questions.explanation: Red blood cells carry oxygen from your lungs to every cell in your body! 🩸
